entities.name: Web3D Consortium
entities.note: The non-profit organization that develops and maintains the X3D standard.

entities.name: Naval Postgraduate School
entities.note: An academic institution heavily involved in X3D research, tool development, and validation.

entities.name: Fraunhofer IGD
entities.note: A German research institute that developed X3DOM and the Aopt optimization tool.

entities.name: Don Brutzman
entities.note: A key contributor to X3D and lead developer of X3D-Edit and X3DJSAIL.

entities.name: John Carlson
entities.note: A Web3D community member who developed X3DJSONLD and advanced X3D JSON encoding.

entities.name: Michalis Kamburelis
entities.note: The lead developer of the Castle Game Engine, view3dscene, and x3d-tidy.

entities.name: X3D 4.0
entities.note: The latest major version of the Extensible 3D Graphics standard.

entities.name: X3D 3.3
entities.note: The previous major version of the X3D standard.

entities.name: VRML97
entities.note: The predecessor to X3D, standardized as ISO/IEC 14772.

entities.name: glTF
entities.note: The GL Transmission Format, often used as an export or conversion target from X3D.

entities.name: X3DUOM
entities.note: The X3D Unified Object Model, an XML representation of the X3D architecture used to generate language bindings.

entities.name: X3D-Edit
entities.note: An open-source, XML-based authoring tool for X3D scenes.

entities.name: X3D-Edit 4.0
entities.note: The modern release of X3D-Edit supporting X3D 4.0 features.

entities.name: Blender
entities.note: A popular open-source 3D creation suite that includes X3D import and export capabilities.

entities.name: Blender X3D exporter
entities.note: An add-on for Blender that allows exporting scenes to the X3D format.

entities.name: X3DJSONLD
entities.note: A tool and library for converting and loading X3D JSON encoded files.

entities.name: x3d-tidy
entities.note: A command-line tool for formatting and converting X3D ClassicVRML files.

entities.name: Aopt
entities.note: A powerful command-line tool by Fraunhofer IGD for optimizing and converting 3D models.

entities.name: MeshLab
entities.note: An open-source system for processing and editing 3D triangular meshes, supporting X3D.

entities.name: Castle Model Converter
entities.note: A tool to convert various 3D formats, including X3D, to glTF.

entities.name: X3D Schematron
entities.note: A set of Schematron rules used to validate the semantic correctness of X3D XML files.

entities.name: X3D XML Schema
entities.note: The XSD files used to validate the structural correctness of X3D XML documents.

entities.name: X3D Validator
entities.note: A comprehensive online tool for validating X3D scenes against multiple quality assurance rules.

entities.name: X3DPSAIL
entities.note: The X3D Python Scene Access Interface Library, generated from X3DUOM.

entities.name: X3DJSAIL
entities.note: The X3D Java Scene Access Interface Library, generated from X3DUOM.

entities.name: X3DOM
entities.note: An open-source JavaScript framework for integrating X3D into HTML5.

entities.name: X_ITE
entities.note: An open-source JavaScript library for rendering X3D and VRML in WebGL.

entities.name: Castle Game Engine
entities.note: A cross-platform 3D and 2D game engine with native support for X3D.

entities.name: Titania
entities.note: An open-source X3D editor and authoring tool.

entities.name: view3dscene
entities.note: A viewer for X3D and VRML models, part of the Castle Game Engine ecosystem.

entities.name: X3D JSON encoding
entities.note: The JSON-based encoding format for X3D scenes.

entities.name: X3D XML encoding
entities.note: The XML-based encoding format for X3D scenes.

entities.name: X3D ClassicVRML encoding
entities.note: The text-based encoding format for X3D scenes, derived from VRML97.
